name: Mugiwara Boushi to Suihen no Yousei
original_name: 麦わら帽子と水辺の妖精
source:
Watching girls by the waterside in summer!
A girl with straw hat and her friend plays in the water at the park
They take off the clothes that got wet and go around naked.
Let's play with such innocent girls!
